description: Permanently delete one specific message. IRREVERSIBLE. Requires the View Channel and Read Message History permissions to find the message. The bot can then delete its own messages; deleting another user's message also requires the Manage Messages permission. Use discord_bulk_delete_messages to remove many at once. Discord does not record a reason for a single message delete in the audit log.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the message.

message_id.description: ID of the message to delete.

reason.description: Optional. Not recorded: Discord keeps no audit log reason for a single message delete.

name: discord_delete_message
